Name: Kyuya's Iridium Tools Continued
Author: sugarmaples
Description:
Hi! This is another unofficial continuation of Kyuya258369's mods. The sprites are made by me, but draw heavy inspiration from her artwork. The mod includes the Deluxe Iridium Rod as well as the Iridium Pan (pan form, sadly not hat form yet). 

You WILL need to download Kyuya258369's original mod to have all of the sprites. It can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5851]here[/url].

Donation Points are turned OFF for this mod, as per Kyuya's page. [b]If you are Kyuya and you would like me to take this down, please let me know here or on 小红书 (ID:6159772224)[/b].

I've also made a patch for the iridium scythe, found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38914]here[/url].
